    limit = {
      has_variable = skonester_selected_faith_var
      has_variable = skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key
    }
    var:skonester_selected_faith_var = {
      if = {

      }
      if = {
        limit = { var:skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_anointment_permitted }

      }
      if = {
        limit = { var:skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_bastardry_all }

      }
      if = {
        limit = { var:skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_bastardry_legitimization }

      if = {
        limit = { var:skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:doctrine_bastardry_none }
